reviews.text: A truly awesome professor. Is hilarious in class and has a good balance of work and fun in his class. 3 tests, chapter assignments on Connect each week. If you put in the work, there are no surprises and should be an easy good grade.
Uses a flipped classroom style. Do the readings and then come to class to clarify questions and get a full understanding. Weekly online homework, but they help with understanding the material.
If you complete the work on time and practice multiple choice questions like the ones on the quizzes, you should be fine and get a good grade.

Dr. [name hidden] is an incredibly caring professor who clearly wants the best for his students. Grading is mainly two mid-term exams and online quizzes throughout the year, and he also offers a low exam adjustment which helps students who improve over the semester.

This class is definitely challenging, but if you put in the work and stay ahead of your assignments, you will be fine. Professor [name hidden] makes it his mission to support you and help you succeed in any way.

I really enjoyed this class with Professor [name hidden] and it's clear that he wants all of his students to succeed. just do the homework, study the quizzes, and use the materials he provides to prepare for exams (every exam was very similar to what he said it would be). overall a very good option for 205 and would recommend taking him

This is a very difficult class; however, if you put the time into it and genuinely try to succeed, it is very possible. He has a flipped classroom, which means basically all of your learning will be done through online lectures and textbook reading, and then will be reinforced in class. Other than that, he is a great professor.

His tests are very do-able and almost identical to the practice tests. The hardest part of the course is the problem sets hw. Not hard to get an A in this class if you show up willing to learn - just take easier classes with it that semester and it will not be too crazy.

Will teach you so much, but way more work than any other micro teacher.  very clear on what he wants you to know for the tests. If you are willing to work a lot, it's worth it; if you have not taken econ in high school and just need to pass, not worth it for the work.

Dr. [name hidden] is a very nice professor who has high standards. He expects a lot from his students, but you will do well if you follow his instructions. He is very helpful, responds to emails in a timely manner and will explain concepts in office hours if you are unsure. Yes, it is a hard class, but he wants you to succeed! You learn a lot!! Recommend!

[name hidden] is a good professor. If you do the work you will do well on everything. He gives a lot of work, but is a great guy and knows what he is talking about. Would recommend over other "easy" econ profs.

He will get you to understand econ, whether you want to or not. Daily quizzes on reverse classroom online lectures. Practice problems and more lectures during class. Will cold call during class, but little pressure. Tests and exams were 100% manageable. He will curve your final grade if you show improvement too. Great person and can really teach.
The classes are hard. But he gives you everything you need to succeed. He gives you the exam questions weeks before the exam. Do the homework, go to the office hours and pay attention in class.
Pros: Good professor. classes are very hands on and engaging. knowledgeable. Cons: very intimidating. tough grader.

He's super chill and lets us call him by his first name. The material actually sticks because he makes everything interesting with his random funny stories. don't think it's an easy A just cause he's laid back. You gotta do the hw and practice constantly. But fr if you put in decent effort you will be okay.

The expectations when you start this clear are very high, but [name hidden] makes them extremely clear. I can't say I didn't learn a lot, because truly, I really enjoyed the content and [name hidden] does a great job of teaching the content, sometimes it just gets a bit harder than it has to be because of some policies [name hidden] has.

As an international student, I love the perspective [name hidden] brings to class. He ties real-world problems into everything and you can tell he cares about us learnin not just for the grade but for life after college. His teaching is hads on and he is funny. If you want to actually learn something useful I will recommend his class.

[name hidden] is charismatic. He is encouraging in office hours. You need to be on your toes as he moves pretty quickly through material. However, he pushes his students towards excellence with challenging exams and a real-world group project in connection with a real business. You will be rewarded by learning a lot and gaining great skills for a résumé.
Practice tests were exactly the same as the exams. If you do the practice tests and problems you will get an A.

Gives lots of practice that helps make learning easier. There are quizzes before each test, each worth 2.5%, that cover the same topics as the exams. This makes prepping for the exams so much easier. Always accessible outside of class and cares about helping his students.

[name hidden] is great. The class is not difficult if you pay attention and exams were a direct reflection of what we learned in class. He was accessible outside of class and helpful if you need help. Your grade is largely exam based (roughly 50%) with 1/4 of the grade coming from a lenient final project. Would recommend.

Not only is [name hidden] super funny, but he truly cares about his students. The lectures can be confusing at times, but if you review the material outside of class, you'll be set up for success. His exams are fair, and his study guides tell you exactly what you need to know.

[name hidden] is a character and a great guy. He may not be the absolute best teacher in the world, but he will make sure everyone succeeds. The practices are EXACTLY the same as the quizzes/exams and as long as you pay attention in class this class will be extremely easy. you also get a cheat sheet and a premade excel cheat sheet for exams
He is the best professor in B-school. This is an easy class, and he is pretty enthusiastic and easygoing. Take his class if you can!

She is recently getting a bad rep. Yes, this class is hard if you don't have it in you to study a lot during the week but I think an A is very achievable for everyone which is why I still think shes a great option and a lot nicer than gets credit for.

Dr. [name hidden] has some bad rep but I really enjoyed her teaching style. She is willing to help, and is always transparent with you. Due to having many classes, she will recommend you get a tutor, but that means ONE ON ONE help so it's nice. If you study regularly, are attentive, and do all the work you will be fine.

For the most part, Dr. [name hidden]'s class wasn't bad. If you put the time into understanding the material you should get an A. If Calculus doesn't come naturally to you, it might be a little bit harder because she moves quickly, but it is still manageable. One downside is that Dr. [name hidden] doesn't respond quickly outside of class, so be ready to wait.

Cares so much about her students and genuinely wants you to succeed. Will always do what she can to help you. Pretty easy class but this was a lower-level class. Def recommend her. Also she is just a great person and has a good teaching style. Mastery based grading system def takes weight off your shoulders and helps u focus on ur work not grade

Professor [name hidden] wants her students to succeed and get good grades - she does no grading grading system (you just have to take a question per each unit on the test and once you pass all of them you don't have to take the final). She provides good videos before her lectures and gives many mental health days. Easy A in calc with minimal work

Dr. [name hidden] is by far the best professor I've had at UR. She breaks down concepts to ensure everyone from all levels of mathematics can understand. I highly recommend any of her classes, but they fill up fast. 
-Uses mastery-based grading system
-Has mental-health days built into class schedule
She is clear about her expectations, classes can be a little boring but she does activities to make it more interesting. Projects were fun and she is a fair grader.
very easy class, spent very little time outside of class on work. class can be boring and quizzes are sometimes confusing, would just recommend taking notes. you can use cheat sheet on the quizzes

I've taken two of her classes and loved both! She's super chill, as long as you take good notes and don't forget the online textbook homework you should do well, and she's always willing to talk about things outside of class. I don't agree at all with people saying her tests are hard, the application is usually related to in-class examples.

This class was super chill and [name hidden] is very nice. On 2/3  of the quizzes (basically tests), we were allowed a cheat sheet, and they were pretty straightforward anyway. Lecture heavy, but if you take good notes you should be totally fine. Not much homework and no final just a final project and v short presentation.

[name hidden] is amazing!  There are always chances for extra credit after the exam which will increase your grade. She is very clear on her criteria. There is not much work to do outside of the classroom. People say her exams are hard but I disagree. They are open note, and are more about your overall understanding.

Prof. [name hidden] is super sweet and very knowledgeable on Environmental Studies. There were some long textbook homework's, but easy work. Her exams are a bit tricky, but she let us use a page of notes while taking them to back up your answers. The final project was a lot of fun as a graphic designer conveying a message about environmental sustainability
